requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/capitalize.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/capitalize_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func Capitalize(s string) string`. Upper-case the first character and lower-case the rest (ASCII). An empty string returns an empty string.
acceptance_criteria: func Capitalize(s string) string: Upper-case the first character and lower-case the rest (ASCII). An empty string returns an empty string.
